basis: Reactive eosinophilic blood disorder with immune-mediated tissue injury; persistent cutaneous involvement ~50%. Direct pulmonary damage is not consistently >=30% across secondary causes.

decisions.pulmonary: none: reported respiratory involvement includes symptoms; direct pulmonary injury is not established in >=30% across secondary causes.
decisions.infectious_immune: primary: reactive cytokine-driven eosinophilic inflammation causes immune-mediated tissue injury.

basis: Leucine metabolism disorder; movement abnormalities are annotated 30-79%, but persistent neural injury is not established. Hypotonia alone does not establish muscle damage.

decisions.neurologic: none: movement abnormalities (30-79%) do not establish lasting neural injury; expression includes asymptomatic individuals and transient metabolic crises.

basis: Oral cavity is the predominant origin across this histologic umbrella. Upper-airway and cutaneous origins belong to minority site-specific forms.

decisions.pulmonary: none: nasal and laryngeal origins occur in minority subtypes and do not characterize most patients across the umbrella.
decisions.dermatologic: none: plantar and other cutaneous forms are minority subtypes; skin origin does not characterize most patients.

basis: Thiamine transport disorder with severe brain maldevelopment; osteoporosis occurs in 30-79%. Optic atrophy and foveal hypoplasia are reported in only one assessed patient.

decisions.ocular: none: optic atrophy and foveal hypoplasia are reported in 1/1 assessed patient; this isolated observation does not establish >=30% prevalence.

basis: Autoimmune thyroid hyperfunction. Proptosis is annotated 30-79%, but damaging orbitopathy is separately diagnosed; tachycardia and enzyme elevations alone do not establish organ injury.

decisions.ocular: none: frequent proptosis and eyelid signs do not establish damaging ocular disease; thyroid-associated orbitopathy is separately diagnosed.

basis: ETFA-related MADD: lipid-storage myopathy is common (>30%); hepatic dysfunction estimated >=30%, especially in neonatal disease. Cardiac injury is not reliably >=30%.

decisions.hepatic: involved: hepatic dysfunction is common in severe neonatal ETFA-MADD; estimated >=30% across this generally severe gene-defined group.
decisions.cardiovascular: none: cardiomyopathy occurs in severe presentations, but >=30% across ETFA-MADD is not established; cardiomyopathy ancestry alone is insufficient.

basis: Fazio-Londe disease is a bulbar motor neuropathy within riboflavin transporter deficiency. Dysphagia, stridor and diaphragmatic weakness reflect denervation.

decisions.metabolic_endocrine: primary: Fazio-Londe disease belongs to riboflavin transporter deficiency, an inherited vitamin transport and metabolism disorder.

basis: Ischemia directly injures the intestine. Intrinsic vascular damage is not required; nonocclusive hypoperfusion also causes this disorder.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: inadequate bowel perfusion does not itself establish vessel disease; causal thrombosis or atherosclerosis is a separate condition.

basis: Type II collagen skeletal dysplasia; significant myopia and vitreoretinal abnormalities affect roughly 40-50% or more in major forms. Hearing involvement is less consistently >=30%.

decisions.ocular: involved: significant myopia and vitreoretinal abnormalities occur in roughly 40-50% or more in major forms, including SED congenita and Stickler syndrome.

basis: Mitochondrial encephalopathy; cardiomyopathy 8/15 (~53%) and brittle hair 6/11 (~55%). Respiratory failure reflects neuromuscular dysfunction; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.

decisions.pulmonary: none: respiratory insufficiency reflects neurologic or neuromuscular failure; direct lung or airway disease is not established.
decisions.dermatologic: involved: brittle hair in 6/11 (~55%) represents persistent structural damage to hair shafts.
